name: Michael Alig
context: Ernie's friend, roommate from the summer of 1990 and, for about five years, his biggest fan: he hired Ernie to appear, go-go dance and bartend at his parties and made him his daytime man at Project X. Ernie says he wrote to him and visited him in prison, forgave him, let him stay after his release and later asked him to move out; they co-hosted Peeew!

name: Ernie Glam

fashion: Workshopped the Ernie Glam look in Philadelphia clubs; made his own clothes
